svg.title: Business Process to Capability Mapping — WHO Models

a.title: Personal Health Records Access and Sharing (Value Stream)
Personal Health Records Archiving and Disposal (Value Stream)
Health Data Validation and Quality Assurance (Business Function)
Validate accuracy of new health data entries (Business Process)
Update patient records with continuous health interventions (Business Process)
Manage corrections and amendments in records (Business Process)
Verify patient identity and eligibility (Business Process)
Collect patient demographic and health information (Business Process)
Capture and digitize physical health records (Business Process)
Input patient consent and privacy preferences (Business Process)
Access Control and Privacy Management (Business Function)
Manage patient consent for data sharing (Business Process)
Authorize access based on role and purpose (Business Process)
Monitor data access and usage (Business Process)
Define retention periods for health records (Business Process)
Archive inactive or legacy records securely (Business Process)
Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements (Business Process)

g.text: Colour: which part of the architecture a box belongs to
Strategy: what the organisation is able to do (capabilities) and with what (resources, value streams)
Business: people, roles and organisations, the processes they carry out and the information they use
Shape: what kind of thing a box is (its small italic label names the exact kind)
Rounded corners: something done or an ability, such as a capability, process or function
Rounded ends: a service, offered for others to use
A box inside another box: a part of it
Note: a comment from the authors
Line: how two boxes are related, read from where the line starts to where it ends
Triggering: triggers (happens first, and starts the end)
Association: is related to (no more specific meaning)
